# Package `iter`

```go
package iter
```

Package iter provides basic definitions and operations related to iterators over sequences.

## Functions

### func Pull

```go
func Pull[V any](seq Seq[V]) (next func() (V, bool), stop func())
```

Pull converts the push-style iterator sequence seq into a pair of functions: next, which returns the next value in the sequence, and stop, which stops the sequence. The caller must call stop if it does not consume the sequence fully.

### func Pull2

```go
func Pull2[K, V any](seq Seq2[K, V]) (next func() (K, V, bool), stop func())
```

Pull2 converts the push-style iterator sequence seq into a pair of functions: next, which returns the next pair in the sequence, and stop, which stops the sequence. The caller must call stop if it does not consume the sequence fully.

## Types

### type Seq

```go
type Seq[V any] func(yield func
```

Seq is an iterator over sequences of individual values.

### type Seq2

```go
type Seq2[K, V any] func(yield func
```

Seq2 is an iterator over sequences of pairs of values.
